Grace keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening. The flower market has become an important part of daily life. Also, backups safeguard the family photos.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Best of all, they walked the ridge at sunrise.

On Thursday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Little by little, things began to change. For example, the escarpment drops sharply to the plain.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, follow the marked trail to the lake.
